d:
Chhath mahaparv ke samapan ke bad kendriy mantri chirag pasvan bhavuk najar aae.
Chhathi maiya ki puja aur ugte sury ko arghy dene ke bad unhonne is mahaparv ko lekar apni bhavnaen jahir kin.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
